conbody.p: If the ROE is not linked to a period of employment or if the ROE is linked to a period of employment without a corresponding electronic ROD or ADJ WI, the agent must complete the Resolve Issue section of the ROE RFS Action WI before completing the WI. When resolving the issue, the agent must review the ROE and the existing RODs.

If the ROE was issued with comments in block 18 , the agent must determine if the correct RFS is indicated on the ROE. Any required changes to the RFS details must be made in the Resolve Issue section of the ROE RFS Action WI.

section.title: Reviewing existing records of decision (RODs) on file

conbody.p: If the RFS is contentious and there is an existing ROD, the agent must determine if the information on the ROE contradicts the decision on file. When a ROD is not found or when the information on the ROE contradicts the ROD, the agent indicates that no decision matches the ROE when completing the Resolve Issue section of the ROE RFS Action WI.
